prompt: Mobile clients on app v4.2 started getting silently logged out exactly 30 days after login; since the 03:00 UTC config push the /token endpoint returns invalid_grant on refresh for ~4k users/hour, even though our refresh-token TTL is 90 days and the token itself isn't expired. Find why.

After we split billing onto api-billing.acme.io, requests carrying a freshly issued access token get 401 invalid_token 'audience not allowed' at the billing gateway, while the same token still works on api.acme.io. About 600 401s/min.

Since the 14:20 deploy, users clicking 'Export CSV' on reports-svc get 403 insufficient_scope, but login and dashboards work fine. Tokens are issued normally and aren't expired. Support has 50+ tickets.

Our SPA login intermittently fails at the token exchange with invalid_grant 'PKCE verification failed' for ~8% of attempts, ever since we shipped an 'open in new tab' flow. It's mostly desktop Chrome users who keep two login tabs open.

One canary pod, orders-svc-7c9, rejects roughly 30% of otherwise-valid access tokens with 'token used before issued' / exp errors since 02:10, while the other 11 pods are healthy. The same tokens validate everywhere else.
Starting 09:05, nearly 100% of token validations at edge-auth fail with 'unable to find signing key for kid=rsa-2026-06'. The IdP team rotated signing keys this morning. No one can reach any API.

After last night's frontend release moved the callback from /auth/callback to /oauth/callback, prod logins die at the IdP with 'redirect_uri_mismatch' before any token is issued. Staging logins work fine.

Security flagged that access tokens are showing up in our analytics vendor's server logs as Referer header values. Our callback page returns the token in the URL fragment and loads a third-party analytics script. Stop the leak without killing analytics.

We migrated the IdP host from login.acme.io to id.acme.io behind the same pool. Since the 11:00 cutover, api-gateway rejects new tokens with 'issuer not trusted: https://id.acme.io', while older tokens still pass. About 2k 401s/min.
About 5% of OIDC logins fail at the relying party with 'nonce mismatch' since we put the login page behind a CDN. Users who retry succeed. The id_token signature is valid; only the nonce check fails.

Backend service sync-worker stopped getting tokens at 00:00 UTC with 401 invalid_client from the token endpoint on its client_credentials grant. Ops rotated client secrets in Vault last night, and now essentially all sync jobs are failing.

During the 18:00 traffic spike, about 40% of token requests from the checkout fleet get HTTP 429 from the IdP /token endpoint and logins stall, yet IdP node CPU is only at 35%. Why are we being throttled when there's headroom?

After we set SameSite=Lax on session cookies, about 20% of logins fail with 'state parameter mismatch' at the callback, heavily skewed toward users returning from the IdP via a form_post (POST) response_mode. GET-based callbacks are unaffected.

Our api-gateway uses RFC 8693 token exchange to mint a downstream token for ledger-svc, but since the 16:30 policy deploy ledger-svc returns 403 'actor not permitted' even though the subject token is valid and the user is authorized. About 300 failures/min.
